[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T13:32:51Z, by staff] BioCryst Announces U.S. FDA Approval of ORLADEYO® 150 mg Oral Pellets
BioCryst Pharmaceuticals received U.S. FDA approval for its new 150 mg oral pellet formulation of ORLADEYO (berotralstat) for the prevention of hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks.
BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved its supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for an oral pellet formulation of ORLADEYO (berotralstat). This new 150 mg formulation is indicated for the prophylactic treatment of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older. The company developed this alternative administration option to support patients who may have difficulty swallowing capsules or who prefer a different method of administration. This approval expands the available delivery options for the company's flagship HAE therapy.
